model_annotation: The bar chart, Figure 5, illustrates the area dedicated to vineyards in seven leading countries globally, categorized by vineyard size, over the period from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis lists the years from 2013 to 2022 in chronological order, while the vertical axis is labeled "Хил. хектара" (Thousand hectares) and ranges from 0 to 1200 in increments of 200. The bars are grouped by year and colored according to country, with a legend on the right side indicating the corresponding countries: Spain (blue), France (orange), China (gray), Italy (yellow), Turkey (light blue), USA (green), and Argentina (dark green). The chart shows a general trend of stable or slightly decreasing vineyard areas across most countries over the decade, with some fluctuations, and Spain consistently having the largest area dedicated to vineyards, while Argentina has the smallest among the represented countries.
